declare -- Jairam added per IM 5326 on 26-apr-2011
 v_local_time date;

BEGIN
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time); 
 
 else

 end if;

 end if;
end if;

END;

DECLARE
 v_string varchar2(230);
 v_temp varchar2(6):='HOLDS';
 chp_sysdate date;
BEGIN
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, :ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate);
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate := sysdate;

 end if; 
 
 show_window('window4');
 go_block('donor_interdictions');
 clear_block(no_validate);

 go_block('donation_interdictions');
 clear_block(no_validate);

 :ctrl_blk_1.s_deferral_id:=:donations.deferral_id;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_tr_id:=:donations.transaction_id;

 if :donations.donor_id is not null then
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_hold_donor_id := :donations.donor_id;
 select first_name || ' , ' || last_name 
 into :ctrl_blk_1.s_hold_name 
 from donors
 where donor_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_hold_donor_id;
 else
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_hold_name:=null;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_hold_donor_id := :donations.transaction_id;
 end if;

 go_block('donor_interdictions');
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_select_donor:='A';

 if :donations.donor_id is not null then
 v_string:=':ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,:ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate) and ' ||
 ' donor_id=:donations.donor_id and inter_type = '||''''||v_temp||'''';
 else
 v_string:=':ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,:ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate) and ' ||
 ' transaction_id=:donations.transaction_id and inter_type = '||''''||v_temp||'''';
 end if;

 set_block_property('donor_interdictions',default_where,v_string);
 :system.message_level:=10;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level:=0;

 -------------------------
 go_block('donation_interdictions');
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_select_unit:='A';

 v_string:='(term_date is null or term_date > :ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate ) and ' ||
 ' transaction_id=:donations.transaction_id and inter_type = '||''''||v_temp||'''';
 
 set_block_property('donation_interdictions',default_where,v_string);
 
 :system.message_level:=10;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level:=0;

-------------------------
 go_item('donor_interdictions.pb_close');

EXCEPTION 
 when no_data_found then
 null;
END;

 procedure add_and(pl_string in out varchar2) is
 begin
 if pl_string is not null then
 pl_string:=pl_string||' and ';
 else
 pl_string:=null;
 end if;
 end;


BEGIN
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, :ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate);
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else

IF :ctrl_blk_1.s_inter_codes is null and
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date is null and
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date is null and
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_drive_id is null and

 ' UNION select transaction_id from donor_interdictions where transaction_id=donations.transaction_id and inter_type ='||v_holds||') and rownum < :global.max_row' ;

 v_inter_string:=' drive_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_drive_id';

 add_and(v_inter_string);
 v_inter_string:=v_inter_string||' deferral_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_def_id';
 end if;
 
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date is not null then
 add_and(v_inter_string);

 end if;

 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_set is not null then
 add_and(v_inter_string);
 v_inter_string:=v_inter_string||' set_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_set';
 end if;
 
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_trans_id is not null then

 end if;


 if v_inter_string is not null then
 v_inter_string:=v_inter_string||' and ';
 end if;

 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_inter_codes is null then
 v_inter_string:=v_inter_string|| ' chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and deferral_id is not null and exists '||

 '(select transaction_id from donation_interdictions where unit_id is null and inter_code in '||'('||:ctrl_blk_1.s_inter_codes||')' ||' and transaction_id=donations.transaction_id and inter_type ='||v_holds||' and (term_date is null or term_date > :ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate) ' ||
 'UNION select transaction_id from donor_interdictions where '||
 ' inter_code in '||'('||:ctrl_blk_1.s_inter_codes||')' ||' and transaction_id=donations.transaction_id and inter_type ='||v_holds||' and :ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,:ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate) )' ; 
 end if;

END IF; 

 set_block_property('donations',default_where,v_inter_string);
 execute_query;

 begin
 first_record;
 If :donations.deferral_id is not null then
 loop
 v_count:=v_count+1;
 if :system.last_record='TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 end loop;
 End if;
 :ctrl_blk_1.c_query_count:=v_count;
 
 end;
 
 first_record;

 if :donations.deferral_id is null then
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date');
 else
 enable_disable('D');
 change_status; 
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Y2K Checked and verified - By Edwin 07/19/1999 */

PROCEDURE do_inter_retrieve IS
 cursor inter_cur is Select a.inter_code,b.inter_desc from valid_regint_reasons a,
 valid_interdictions b where substr(a.inter_reason,1,4)=:ctrl_blk_1.s_group_id and
 a.inter_code=b.inter_code order by 1;

 Cursor inter_cur1 is select inter_code,inter_desc from valid_interdictions where inter_type='HOLDS' and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) order by 1;
BEGIN
 go_block('inter_block');
 clear_block(no_validate);

 If :ctrl_blk_1.s_group_id is not null then
 go_block('inter_block');
 set_block_property('inter_block',insert_allowed,property_true);

 FOR inter_cur_rec IN inter_cur loop
 :inter_block.inter_code:=inter_cur_rec.inter_code;
 :inter_block.inter_desc:=inter_cur_rec.inter_desc;
 :inter_block.s_select:='Y';
 create_record;
 END LOOP;
 first_record;
 go_item('inter_block.inter_code');
 set_item_property('inter_block.inter_code',insert_allowed,property_false);
 set_item_property('inter_block.inter_desc',insert_allowed,property_false);
 Else
 go_block('inter_block');
 set_block_property('inter_block',insert_allowed,property_true);

 FOR inter_cur_rec IN inter_cur1 loop
 :inter_block.inter_code:=inter_cur_rec.inter_code;
 :inter_block.inter_desc:=inter_cur_rec.inter_desc;
 :inter_block.s_select:='N';
 create_record;
 END LOOP;
 first_record;
 go_item('inter_block.inter_code');
 set_item_property('inter_block.inter_code',insert_allowed,property_false);
 set_item_property('inter_block.inter_desc',insert_allowed,property_false);
End if;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_WINDOW_PROGRAM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE call_window_program (p_window_name varchar2) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dondata'; 
 save_version_no varchar2(100);
BEGIN 

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 end if;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_donor_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :donations.donor_id);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_trans_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :donations.transaction_id);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_unit_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :donations.deferral_id);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_def_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :donations.deferral_id);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_chapter_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :global.chapter_id); 

 if p_window_name='DRWHOLDS' then
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_coll_date', TEXT_PARAMETER, to_char(:donations.coll_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')); 
 end if;

 save_version_no:=name_in('global.program_version'); 
 call_form( lower(p_window_name) ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,NO_QUERY_ONLY ,pl_id);
 copy(save_version_no,'global.program_version');
 
END;

DECLARE

 l_print_id VARCHAR2(40);
 l_error VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN
 populate_chapter_ID(l_chp_id, l_print_id, l_error);
 IF l_error IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF l_error in ('9776','9777') THEN
 show_error(l_error); -- Message Type
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));
 pause;
 END IF; 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;
